content.text:
Flyer built and rendered; all three sizes are defect-free.

- **Structure**: one full-bleed column frame (`width/height: fill`) so bands stretch edge-to-edge at every size — headline, photo band, candidate row, red CTA bar, steps, spacer, footer.
- **Columns**: three `flexGrow: 1` frames in a row, so Dana Levi / Omar Haddad / Ruth Cohen stay evenly spaced at any width.
- **Photo**: `fit: cover` with focus, so it crops instead of distorting; it flexes between min/max heights per size.
- **Per-size `media`** tuned headline, CTA, step and footer type plus paddings — fixed the wide `!overflow` (1016px needed) and the sky `!truncated` footer.

Renders: `portrait-v6.png`, `wide-v6.png`, `sky-v6.png`.
